headline: New appointment: Barrister Mosharraf Hossain takes charge as CID chief
summary: The legal expert takes over the leadership of the Criminal Investigation Department of the Bangladesh Police.
details: Barrister Mosharraf Hossain has officially assumed his role as the chief of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).
The appointment comes as part of the ongoing administrative changes within the law enforcement agencies of Bangladesh.
As CID chief, Barrister Hossain will lead the specialized unit responsible for conducting high-profile criminal investigations.
The department's focus remains on ensuring justice and maintaining law and order through rigorous investigative processes.
caption:
A new leader for the CID. Barrister Mosharraf Hossain officially takes charge.

Barrister Mosharraf Hossain has officially assumed his role as the chief of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).

The department's focus remains on ensuring justice and maintaining law and order through rigorous investigative processes.

headline: Barishal City Corporation appoints first transgender employee
summary: Maidul Islam Abhi, proficient in computer operations, joins the civic body to help eliminate discrimination.
details: The Barishal City Corporation (BCC) has appointed its first transgender employee, Maidul Islam Abhi, in a historic first for the civic body.
BCC Administrator Bilkis Akter Jahan Shirin handed over the appointment letter to Abhi, a resident of Zia Road in Ward No. 22 of Barishal city.
Abhi was appointed on a temporary basis based on his proficiency in computer operations, and the administrator will assign him appropriate responsibilities.
Overcome with emotion, Abhi shared that he never imagined his academic certificates would be useful after years of uncertainty.
Abhi lives with his 95-year-old grandmother and a younger brother with a disability, having lost both parents nine years ago.
caption:
A historic first for Barishal City Corporation: a transgender person has been appointed to a job at the civic body.

The Barishal City Corporation (BCC) has appointed its first transgender employee, Maidul Islam Abhi, in a historic first for the civic body.

BCC Administrator Bilkis Akter Jahan Shirin handed over the appointment letter to Abhi, a resident of Zia Road in Ward No. 22 of Barishal city.

Abhi was appointed on a temporary basis based on his proficiency in computer operations, and the administrator will assign him appropriate responsibilities.

Overcome with emotion, Abhi shared that he never imagined his academic certificates would be useful after years of uncertainty.

Abhi lives with his 95-year-old grandmother and a younger brother with a disability, having lost both parents nine years ago.
